title: Migration
description: Owns .guild conversion and migration tooling. sync-migration.ts is parameterized (--canonical/--target; defaults still assume this umbrella workspace's own MIGRATION.md pointer-stub layout) but remains operator-workspace-specific self-build tooling — every real script must have exactly one module owner (validateModuleOwnership), so it stays listed here; there is no per-resource ship/no-ship flag in the module-resources packaging system today (a real gap, not fixed by this pass — see the plugin-audit-remediation ledger).
